illustration_style: Hand-painted gouache and coloured-pencil festive illustration with a refined, nostalgic storybook finish for an adult Christmas card.
line_weight: Fine selective pencil outlines, softened by opaque gouache edges.
line_quality: Gently imperfect, hand-drawn and crisp in small decorative details.
detail_level: Moderate detail with intricate focal accents, simplified surrounding forms and generous calm areas for seasonal wording.
background_density: Layered but restrained; atmospheric detail recedes softly to preserve a clear focal hierarchy and open text space.
composition: Clear central focal hierarchy with a broad uncluttered area for elegant greeting typography; balanced vertical flow and quiet negative space.
palette: Deep cobalt and inky navy balanced with warm amber, soft cream, muted berry red and frosted blue-grey neutrals.
shading: Gentle tonal gouache shading, subtle coloured-pencil crosshatching and warm illuminated accents against cool shadow.
texture: Visible cold-press paper grain, dry-brush snow texture and lightly waxy coloured-pencil marks.
mood: Cosy, hopeful, intimate and quietly nostalgic.
print_considerations: Use print-safe midtone values and clear contrast for home printers; avoid very dark full-bleed areas, retain fine details at a readable scale, and allow for trimming and folded-card alignment.
shared_prompt: Hand-painted festive gouache and coloured-pencil illustration on subtly textured cold-press paper, with fine selective pencil outlines, softly simplified storybook forms and crisp decorative details. Full colour in deep cobalt and inky navy, frosted blue-grey, soft cream, muted berry red and warm amber; gentle tonal shading, dry-brush texture, subtle crosshatching and cosy luminous accents. Refined, nostalgic adult Christmas-card mood, with a clear focal hierarchy and generous calm space for elegant serif typography; home-print friendly contrast and restrained ink coverage.
avoid: Any copied or recognisable branded Christmas-card artwork, characters, logos or distinctive compositions
Dense clutter that competes with the greeting
Harsh neon colours or heavy black shadows
Dark full-bleed backgrounds likely to print poorly at home
